title: Provision-to-ready: emit stage timing metrics + structured events; propagate correlation IDs
creator: Vanessa Ortiz
project: Provision-to-ready automation sprint (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)
content:
## Context
We’re rolling out the provision-to-ready pipeline for Dedicated pools. To make it diagnosable + measurable (and to support SLOs/alerting), we need two things:

1) **Aggregated metrics** (low-cardinality) for dashboards/alerts: time-to-ready + stage duration histograms + failure/retry counters.
2) **Structured events** (searchable, higher-cardinality allowed) for drill-down and correlating across services (Terraform wrapper, imaging, bootstrap/Helm, perf-canary, and control plane).

Additionally, we need a stable **correlation_id** propagated end-to-end so we can stitch together traces/logs across components for a single provisioning run.

Confluence spec (authoritative):
- Provision-to-Ready (Dedicated) — Time-to-Ready Metrics, Dashboards, and Alerting (eng-sre)

## Goals
- Emit consistent stage timing metrics from the provisioning state machine transitions.
- Emit structured provisioning events on stage start/finish/failure and pause/resume.
- Add `correlation_id` to: provisioning run records, events, logs, and outbound calls.
- Keep metrics cardinality safe (no run_id/pool_id/customer_id labels).

## Non-goals
- Building the dashboard itself (tracked separately).
- Alert tuning/paging policy (SRE owns; we only provide the signals).
- Redesigning stage taxonomy (must match canonical stages defined in SRE doc).

## Requirements / Canonical stage taxonomy
Stages must match exactly:
- Requested
- Provisioning
- Imaging
- Bootstrapping
- Validating
- Ready
- Failed
- Paused

## Proposed metric + event contract
### Metrics (low-cardinality)
Implement per SRE spec:
- `dedicated.provisioning.time_to_ready_seconds` (histogram, emitted once per successful run)
- `dedicated.provisioning.stage_duration_seconds` (histogram, emitted per stage completion)
- `dedicated.provisioning.paused_seconds` (histogram, emitted per pause interval)
- `dedicated.provisioning.runs_total` (counter, emitted per terminal outcome)
- `dedicated.provisioning.failures_total` (counter, emitted on terminal failure, with normalized category + stage)
- `dedicated.provisioning.stage_retries_total` (counter)
- `dedicated.provisioning.retry_exhausted_total` (counter)

Label set constraints (do not violate):
- Allowed: `environment`, `region`, `gpu_sku`, `stage`, `run_kind`, `pool_type` (where explicitly listed)
- Disallowed: `run_id`, `pool_id`, `customer_id`, `correlation_id`, `terraform_apply_id` (events/logs only)

### Structured events (drill-down)
Emit to `provisioning_events` stream.

Required fields:
- `timestamp`
- `run_id`
- `pool_id`
- `environment`
- `region`
- `gpu_sku`
- `stage`
- `event_type`: `stage_started | stage_completed | stage_failed | run_paused | run_resumed | run_canceled`
- `correlation_id` (propagated; see below)

Optional fields (when available):
- `failure_category` (enum)
- `error_code`, `error_summary` (keep summary short; truncate)
- `retry_attempt`
- `artifact_version` (image version, chart version)
- `terraform_workspace`, `apply_id`
- `perf_canary_summary_json` (truncated)

## Correlation ID propagation
### Source of truth
- Generate a UUID `correlation_id` when creating the provisioning run (Requested).
- Persist on the run record.
- Include it in every event, and attach to logs via context.

### Propagation targets
- Terraform wrapper invocation (as an input var and log field)
- Imaging step runner
- Helm/bootstrap step runner
- Perf-canary invocation (as CLI arg / env var)
- Control plane registration call (header `X-Redwood-Correlation-Id`)

### Logging/tracing
- Ensure logs for all stages include: `run_id`, `pool_id`, `correlation_id`, `stage`.
- Where OpenTelemetry spans exist, add `correlation_id` as a span attribute (NOT as a metric label).

## Implementation plan
1) Add `correlation_id` field to provisioning run model (DB migration) and thread through stage executors.
2) Emit structured events:
   - At stage transition start
   - At stage completion
   - At stage failure
   - On pause/resume/cancel
3) Metrics emission:
   - On stage completion: compute `stage_duration_seconds` from persisted timestamps
   - On Ready: compute `time_to_ready_seconds` (exclude paused intervals per spec)
   - On Failed/Canceled: increment counters + failure category mapping
4) Add normalization:
   - `gpu_sku` mapping to allowlisted values
   - `failure_category` mapping (tight enum)
5) Safeguards:
   - Cardinality linting in review checklist
   - Truncate large fields in events (perf canary JSON)

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Metrics names + labels match SRE page exactly.
- [x] No high-cardinality identifiers appear in metrics labels.
- [x] `provisioning_events` contain required fields and include `correlation_id`.
- [x] For a sample run, we can:
  - Find the run in event search by `run_id`
  - See stage timeline (start/end)
  - Jump to logs via `correlation_id`
  - See metrics updated within 1–2 minutes
- [x] Paused time is excluded from `time_to_ready_seconds` SLO view, and emitted separately.

## Links
- Confluence: Provision-to-Ready (Dedicated) — Time-to-Ready Metrics, Dashboards, and Alerting
- Related work:
  - ENG-2742 (state machine)
  - ENG-2749 (dashboard + alerts)

## Ship vehicle
- Primary PRs expected:
  - redwood PR: structured provisioning events + correlation IDs
  - redwood PR: telemetry histograms/counters + failure category mapping

## Updates

Aligned with Aisha/Rafael on metric names + label sets. Confirmed we must NOT attach `pool_id` / `run_id` labels anywhere; drill-down is events.

### 2025-02-13 (Caleb Johnson)
Started wiring `correlation_id` through the provisioner context object. Noted we currently drop request context when spawning Terraform applies; adding explicit propagation as env var + log field.

### 2025-02-17 (Logan Wright)
Structured events implemented for stage start/complete/fail. Added truncation for error summaries and perf canary payload.
Open question resolved: use header `X-Redwood-Correlation-Id` for control plane calls (Ethan ok).

### 2025-02-19 (Aisha Bello, review)
Requested:
- Ensure `time_to_ready_seconds` excludes paused intervals by default.
- Ensure failure categories map to the enum list in the SRE doc.
- Add explicit tests to prevent accidental addition of `run_id` as a metric label.

### 2025-02-21 (Logan Wright)
Merged telemetry emission with unit tests for label allowlist. Verified in staging: histogram series present and stage durations populate; events searchable by run_id.

### 2025-02-24 (Vanessa Ortiz)
Marked Done after verifying a staging pool run end-to-end: correlation_id shows up in Terraform logs, perf-canary invocation, and control plane registration. Dashboard work tracked in ENG-2749.
